# WIDA fixed decimal BigInt fixture

bigint.cpp preserves exact CRLF blob `fd39b7103c67a148e15a9d09cd508d8bf2efc5c6` from hh2048/XCPC tree `cfdb12db6792eb2303798541fb5c760ed2bc618b`. The full source path is recorded in provenance.json.

Upstream GPL-3.0 is preserved in LICENSE. This comparison fixture is not relicensed under the root MIT license. The harness can seed the public digit array for large test values; this is not an input parser provided by the original source. See docs/WIDA-BIGINT.md for test domains and separately reproduced failures.
